source.title: Raspberry Pi 5 mechanical drawing

coordinate_convention: Viewed from above; PCB lower-left nominal outline is (0,0), long edge is X. Fixture board origin is (edge_margin, edge_margin).

derived_dimensions.hole_offset_y: (56 - 49) / 2 = 3.5 mm, based on symmetric mounting rows in the drawing; verify against a physical board.

rights.policy_observation: The publisher distinguishes online documentation, PDFs and design files; most PDFs are CC BY-ND 4.0. This specific drawing does not print an explicit licence.
rights.distribution: No official PDF, screenshot, board mesh, logo or adapted drawing is redistributed. Code and fixture geometry are original; numerical reference facts are attributed. Raspberry Pi is used only to identify the intended board; no endorsement is implied.
